subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Officials said thousands of office-goers were ________ the Metro, and the trains were running full during peak hours.
solution:
The correct answer is: **taking**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We use "**verb + ing**" to form continuous sentences.
 
• The given sentence is written in the **past continuous tense**.
 
• Let's look at the options given.
 
 
• **Fasting **means to eat no food for a certain time, usually for religious reasons. (उपवास रखना)
 
• **Running **means the action or sport of running. (दौड़ की क्रिया या खेल)
 
• **Taking **means to carry or move somebody/something; to go with somebody from one place to another. (किसी को लेना या ले जाना; किसी के साथ कहीं जाना)
 
• **Adapting **means to become familiar with a new situation and to change your behaviour accordingly. (नई परिस्थिति से परिचित होकर असके अनुरूप अपने व्‍यवहार को बदलना)
 
 

As per the meaning of the given words, "**taking**" is the most appropriate option to fill in.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *Officials said thousands of office-goers were taking __the Metro, and the trains were running full during peak hours. *
